title: CoELA: Cooperative Embodied Language Agents for Decentralized Multi-Agent Cooperation

defines.name: CoELA
defines.definition: A cognitive-inspired modular framework for cooperative embodied agents that uses LLMs to perceive, remember, communicate, plan, and execute in decentralized multi-agent tasks.

problem: Existing embodied multi-agent approaches struggle with decentralized control, partial observation, and costly communication in long-horizon cooperative tasks.
